summary: Backend testing completed for JW GRN Invoice Validation, Editable Price, and BOM Rollup Cost features. 20/25 tests passed. Key findings: (1) JW GRN accepts requests WITHOUT supplier_invoice_no - backend validation is MISSING (bug), (2) JW GRN correctly accepts and stores custom process_charges (editable price works), (3) DC correctly deducts RM stock, (4) JW GRN correctly adds FG/SA stock and completes SC. BOM rollup cost tests via create-sc endpoint require full production order flow which was not fully tested.

critical.issue: Backend does NOT validate supplier_invoice_no as required. GRN can be created without invoice number, which violates the requirement that Invoice No and Date are mandatory for JW GRN.

minor.issue: BOM API requires parent_item_id field, not item_id. Test needed adjustment.

action_items: Add backend validation for supplier_invoice_no and supplier_invoice_date in POST /api/job-work/receive-grn endpoint - these should be required fields
BOM rollup cost feature on SC via create-sc endpoint needs verification with full production order flow
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 6253: supplier_invoice_no uses data.get() with empty string default - should validate as required field
server.py line 6254: supplier_invoice_date also not validated as required
seed_data_creation: Test data created dynamically with TEST_ prefix for items (RM, SA, FG), suppliers, SC orders, DCs, and GRNs
context_for_next_testing_agent: JW GRN features tested: (1) Editable process_charges per line WORKS - custom charges accepted and stored in GRN collection. (2) total_process_cost calculated correctly from custom charges. (3) DC deducts RM stock correctly. (4) JW GRN adds FG/SA stock correctly. (5) JW GRN completes SC when all parts received. CRITICAL BUG: supplier_invoice_no validation is MISSING in backend - GRN can be created without invoice number. BOM rollup cost via create-sc endpoint requires full production order flow (BOM -> Production Order -> Work Order -> create-sc).
